high_level_overview.overview: This JCL job, named **LISTFILS**, catalogs all dataset entries associated with the **CardDemo application** by executing an IDCAMS LISTCAT command against the `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO` dataset level. It first cleans up any pre-existing output file in STEP01, then in STEP05 generates a full catalog listing of all CardDemo-related datasets and saves the results to `AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTCAT`. The business purpose is to provide an inventory and audit trail of all datasets belonging to the CardDemo application, useful for system administration, migration planning, or environment documentation.

parameters.name: JOB NAME
parameters.description: The name assigned to this job, used to identify the job in the system log, job queue, and output listings.

parameters.name: ACCOUNTING INFORMATION
parameters.description: Positional parameter providing accounting information associated with the job, used for billing or tracking purposes.

parameters.name: CLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the job class (input queue) to which the job is submitted. CLASS=A determines the scheduling priority and resource allocation class for the job.

parameters.name: MSGCLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the output class for the job log (JES message log), determining where the system messages and job log are routed after job completion.

parameters.name: NOTIFY
parameters.description: Specifies the TSO user ID to be notified upon job completion. &SYSUID is a symbolic parameter that resolves to the user ID of the person who submitted the job, sending a notification message when the job finishes.

job_details.purpose: Deletes the existing dataset AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTCAT if it exists, using the do-nothing program IEFBR14 to allow JCL DD disposition processing to clean up the file before recreation in the next step.

Executes the IDCAMS LISTCAT command to list all catalog entries under the high-level qualifier AWS.M2.CARDDEMO, capturing full catalog details (ALL) for all datasets in the CARDDEMO application, and writes the output to a new cataloged dataset.
job_details.outputs: SYSPRINT -> AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTCAT (newly cataloged dataset containing the LISTCAT report, RECFM=FBA, LRECL=133)

data_operations.description: IEFBR14 is executed to delete the dataset AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTCAT if it exists. DISP=(MOD,DELETE,DELETE) causes the dataset to be deleted on normal and abnormal termination, effectively cleaning up any pre-existing version of the dataset.

IDCAMS writes the LISTCAT output to the newly cataloged dataset AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTCAT. DISP=(NEW,CATLG,DELETE) creates and catalogs the dataset on normal completion, or deletes it on abnormal termination. The dataset is defined with RECFM=FBA, LRECL=133, on SYSDA with 1 track primary and 1 track secondary space.

IDCAMS executes the LISTCAT command with LEVEL(AWS.M2.CARDDEMO) ALL, reading the system catalog to retrieve and list all catalog entries at the AWS.M2.CARDDEMO level, including all associated attributes and statistics.
